title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
description: Peter Rabbit ignores his mother's warning, slips into Mr McGregor's garden and discovers that stealing vegetables is much easier than escaping with them.
catalogueBlurb: Peter Rabbit sneaks into a forbidden garden and has to find his way home.

cover.alt: Beatrix Potter's original 1902 cover illustration for The Tale of Peter Rabbit.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Beatrix Potter's public-domain 1902 story
text.notes: The underlying 1902 story is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.notes: The selected original Potter illustration files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

rights.curatorNotes: A short classic split into five scene-sized reader sections. R6.5-WP19SH1.6.2 adds a separately selectable generated Modern Illustrations set while preserving the original Beatrix Potter artwork as Classic Illustrations.

rights.notes: The selected original Potter illustration files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

illustrations.alt: Mrs Rabbit stands with Peter, Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-tail outside their warm fir-root burrow.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter lingers by the hedge and looks towards Mr McGregor's tempting garden while his sisters head down the lane.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter squeezes beneath the weathered garden gate into rows of vegetables with the greenhouse and shed beyond.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter sits among lettuces and radishes as Mr McGregor spots him at the far end of the vegetable row.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter races through the vegetable rows as Mr McGregor pursues him and one of Peter's shoes flies loose.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter twists free from the gooseberry net while his blue jacket remains snagged behind him.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Soaked and shivering, Peter hides inside a large watering can in Mr McGregor's tool shed.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter picks his way beneath oversized pots and garden tools while a watchful cat sits near the pond.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter follows a flight of sparrows towards the gate visible beyond the currant bushes.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Peter dives beneath the garden gate towards the bright field while Mr McGregor closes in behind him.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

illustrations.alt: Coatless and shoeless Peter rests warmly in bed with camomile tea while Mrs Rabbit tends him and his sisters eat supper nearby.
illustrations.caption: Modern Story House illustration.

text.source: Beatrix Potter's 1902 text, transcribed in Project Gutenberg eBook #14838
text.notes: Complete story text. Project Gutenberg header, footer, licence text and standalone [Illustration] placeholders are excluded; wording is not abridged or modernised.

illustrations.source: Original 1902 illustrations by Beatrix Potter, Project Gutenberg eBook #14838
illustrations.notes: All 26 narrative illustrations appearing between the opening story text and THE END in the Project Gutenberg HTML edition are included in source order. Story House pagination changes presentation only.

edition.notes: Story House pagination is presentation only; the original wording remains unabridged.

rights.curatorNotes: Complete original text reflowed into 10 reader pages at paragraph boundaries, with all 26 narrative illustrations from the Project Gutenberg 1902 edition restored at their matching passage anchors.
